authority_ladder.A0: Reject or answer-only; no real-world authority.
authority_ladder.A1: Low-impact, reversible, time-limited, independently logged action.
authority_ladder.A2: Bounded pilot with appeal, external stop, rollback, and monitoring.
authority_ladder.A3: Limited deployment authority requiring independent evidence, counter-safety case, separation, ledger, monitoring, and recourse.
authority_ladder.A4: High-impact authority requiring V4 evidence, external replication, tested rollback, tamper-evident monitoring, independent stop ownership.
authority_ladder.A5: Forbidden violation class: domination, appeal closure, evaluator capture, Root protection removal, required deception, irreversible high harm, monopoly revision.

verification_tiers.V1: Some evidence, weak independence or unclear falsification.
verification_tiers.V2: Limited independent evidence sufficient for bounded pilots.
verification_tiers.V3: Multiple independent groups, red-team/audit evidence, affected-party input.
verification_tiers.V4: External replication, contamination controls, multiple independent groups, tamper-evident monitoring.
